## GovernedAuditRecordInput interface

The inputs needed to construct a [GovernedAuditRecord](./core.governedauditrecord.md)<!-- -->.

The timestamp is supplied by the caller (injected, never read from `Date.now()` inside this module) so records are deterministic and testable.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface GovernedAuditRecordInput extends AuditRecordBase
```

**Extends:** [AuditRecordBase](./core.auditrecordbase.md)

</td><td>

_(Optional)_ Optional correlation id tying the records of one held call together.

A `confirm-first` call produces two records — `pending` when it is withheld, then `approved`<!-- -->/`rejected` when a human resolves it. Both carry the same `approvalId`<!-- -->, so overlapping calls with identical capability, requester, and argument summary can still be paired (and their wait time computed). Absent on records for calls that never raised an approval request.

</td></tr>
